## REQ-RES-MAM-001

**Fields of the MAM DataSet**

The Payload of a MAM DataSetMessage contains the mandatory fields Manufacturer (LocalizedText), ManufacturerUri, Model (LocalizedText), ProductCode, HardwareRevision, SoftwareRevision, DeviceRevision, DeviceManual, DeviceClass, SerialNumber, ProductInstanceUri (String each) and RevisionCounter (Int32), and optionally Description (LocalizedText) and GlobalAssetId (String); no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5, MG 8.3.1, MG 8.2.7
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-0ec823e8, MG-5-18d7af65, MG-5-46140157, MG-5-51c8416c, MG-5-55a1eaaa, MG-5-5cddea30, MG-5-661ef283, MG-5-755ace06, MG-5-80c79ba0, MG-5-8774e8c0, MG-5-a288c1d3, MG-5-acac9e54, MG-5-b88773c8, MG-5-cfb31dc9

Notes: Field presence and types per REQ-CMP-025/026; LocalizedText per REQ-MSG-040; undefined keys per REQ-MSG-001 (strict) and REQ-MSG-046 (tolerant). GlobalAssetId is read only and optional (MG 5, SF-064 (c), GL-ADR-019); its SHOULD-provide rule is REQ-RES-MAM-023.

## REQ-RES-MAM-002

**MAM content equals the OPC UA VendorNameplate**

If the vendor implements the optional VendorNameplate Interface of OPC UA Part 100 for the asset, the MAM carries the same data content as that interface, as far as the values satisfy the rules of MG 5 (in particular the ManufacturerUri is a domain name even if the VendorNameplate uses a GUID).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The vendor implements the VendorNameplate Interface of OPC UA Part 100 for the asset.
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-411314b4, MG-5-5a8a5249, MG-5-84fb43b5

> If a vendor has implemented the optional VendorNameplate Interface from OPC UA Part 100, they shall use the same data content for implementing the Master Asset Model information, as far as the values satisfy the rules of this chapter.
> — MG 5

> In particular, the ManufacturerUri must be a domain name (see below), even if the VendorNameplate uses a GUID.
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-003

**Uniform manufacturer name**

The Manufacturer is given in a uniform name representation of the company (the same writing for all assets of the manufacturer).

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-7f9f4557

> It should be noted that uniformity in the name representation should be a goal
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-004

**ManufacturerUri is a domain name without scheme**

The ManufacturerUri is a valid URI according to RFC 3986 in the form of a domain name without scheme (e.g. provider.com, not https://provider.com), optionally with subdomains, and follows the rules of the Oi4Identifier for the ManufacturerUri (MG 4.3.1: lower case, no scheme, port or path).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Scope: MG 4.3.1
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-023701f4, MG-5-14aeb68b, MG-5-85176e42, MG-5-ee170828

> This property shall provide a valid URI to RFC 3986.
> — MG 5

> ManufacturerUri shall be a domain name without scheme (e.g. provider.com, not https://provider.com).
> — MG 5

> ManufacturerUri may contain subdomains.
> — MG 5

Notes: Counterpart of REQ-IL-023/024 (ManufacturerUri of the Oi4Identifier).

## REQ-RES-MAM-005

**ManufacturerUri corresponds to the domain of the Identification Link**

The ManufacturerUri corresponds to the domain of the Identification Link of the asset; in case of doubt it is given without scheme and without third level domain (provider.com, not www.provider.com).

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-2d5ef3c9

> ManufacturerUri should correspond to the domain of the Identification Link of the asset.
> — MG 5

Notes: Same rule as REQ-IL-034 from the view of the MAM.

## REQ-RES-MAM-006

**Generated Oi4Identifier uses the MAM values**

If an OEC application generates an Oi4Identifier as Identification Link of the asset, it uses the ManufacturerUri, Model, ProductCode and SerialNumber of the MAM for its elements, so that both stay consistent; for the LocalizedText Model it uses the Text in the locale en-US (REQ-IL-027).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application generates an Oi4Identifier as Identification Link of the asset.
- Scope: MG 4.3.1
- Refs: MG 5, MG 4.3.1, SF-064
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-1d7325a6, MG-5-afff2382, MG-5-edaabec1

> The ManufacturerUri given for this property shall also be used for the Oi4Identifier of the asset if an Oi4Identifier is generated as Identification Link by an OI4 Alliance-compliant application.
> — MG 5

> The ProductCode given for this property shall also be used for the Oi4Identifier of the asset, if an Oi4Identifier is generated as Identification Link (4.3 The Oi4Identifier).
> — MG 5

> The SerialNumber given for this property shall also be used for the Oi4Identifier of the asset, if an Oi4Identifier is generated as Identification Link (4.3 The Oi4Identifier).
> — MG 5

Notes: Counterpart of REQ-IL-027 (dnp-encoding per REQ-IL-033 allowed); Model in en-US per SF-064 (d). Since 9b6b22f (PO request 2026-10-22) MG 5 no longer states the Model rule; it is stated in MG 4.3.1 (REQ-IL-027), MG 5 only requires en-US availability (REQ-RES-MAM-024).

## REQ-RES-MAM-008

**HardwareRevision**

The HardwareRevision is the manufacturer-internal revision of the hardware and is incremented for subsequent hardware revisions; a physical asset without formalized or with unknown hardware revision uses "undefined" (also instead of the OPC UA default empty string taken from a VendorNameplate); a software-only asset (e.g. an application) uses the empty string.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-37aaf3a1, MG-5-3ef2d14f, MG-5-4060ce8e, MG-5-529e97c9, MG-5-cdffb46b, MG-5-e9aff043

> If for a physical asset a manufacturer does not have a formalized hardware revision, it shall be set by default to "undefined".
> — MG 5

> In this case, the HardwareRevision shall be set to an empty string to detect the differences between hardware- and software-only assets!
> — MG 5

> A hardware with undefined or unknown hardware revision shall set HardwareRevision to undefined.
> — MG 5

> If such a value is taken from the VendorNameplate of a physical asset, the Master Asset Model must use "undefined" instead (for HardwareRevision and SoftwareRevision), except for the cases with an empty string described in the notes of this chapter.
> — MG 5

Notes: Not checked by the payload checks: whether an asset is software-only is not visible in the message (SF-064 (b)).

## REQ-RES-MAM-009

**Revisions as Semantic Versioning or dot-separated four numbers**

HardwareRevision and SoftwareRevision use Semantic Versioning (e.g. 1.0.1, SemanticVersionString of OPC UA Part 100) or a dot-separated schema of four numbers (e.g. 1.0.1.0).

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-100f4000, MG-5-fd63be36

> A recommended best practice is to use Semantic Versioning (e.g. 1.0.1, SemanticVersionString of OPC UA Part 100) or a dot-separated four numbers schema.
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-010

**SoftwareRevision**

The SoftwareRevision is the manufacturer-internal revision of the software installed on the asset and is incremented for subsequent software revisions; an asset without formalized software revision uses "undefined" (also instead of the OPC UA default empty string taken from a VendorNameplate, see REQ-RES-MAM-008).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-420d4317, MG-5-925234e9, MG-5-a058c707

> If for any asset a manufacturer does not have a formalized software revision, it shall be set by default to "undefined".
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-011

**SoftwareRevision of assets without software**

An asset without software (e.g. a pure mechanical part) uses the empty string as SoftwareRevision.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The asset has no software.
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-7c86eedd

> In this case, the SoftwareRevision should be set to an empty string!
> — MG 5

Notes: "undefined" (REQ-RES-MAM-010) applies to software without formalized revision (SF-064 (b)).

## REQ-RES-MAM-012

**DeviceManual points to a human-readable manual**

The DeviceManual contains a URL (with scheme, e.g. https://) that points to a human-readable manual document of the asset; if no manual is available, it is the empty string; a path in a local file system is not used.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-2a2879c1, MG-5-6bf83cbc, MG-5-93b822f3

> A DeviceManual property shall contain a URL (with scheme, e.g. https://) that points to a human-readable manual document for the asset.
> — MG 5

> If no manual is available, the DeviceManual shall be set to an empty string.
> — MG 5

> A path in a local file system (allowed by OPC UA Part 100) must not be used, since it can not be resolved by other participants of the Message Bus.
> — MG 5

Notes: The empty string is used by the device examples of MG B1.1.11 and B1.1.12 (V-PAY-006).

## REQ-RES-MAM-013

**DeviceManual as PDF document**

The manual referenced by DeviceManual is a PDF document.

## REQ-RES-MAM-014

**DeviceClass of OEC applications**

The DeviceClass of an OEC application names its ServiceType in the form Oi4.&lt;ServiceType> (e.g. Oi4.OTConnector).

- Keyword: SHOULD

## REQ-RES-MAM-015

**SerialNumber identifies the instance**

The SerialNumber is a unique identifier of the asset instance; if the asset has no unique serial number, one is generated in an appropriate way (e.g. from a MAC address) so that instances of equal types can be distinguished.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-cc876b07, MG-5-e2ab23f8, MG-5-fdd0975a

> This property shall be a unique identifier for an instance of an asset.
> — MG 5

> If the assets do not have a unique serial number, it shall be generated in an appropriate way to be able to have instances of equal types.
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-016

**ProductInstanceUri is the Identification Link of the asset**

The ProductInstanceUri is the unencoded Identification Link of the asset as used in AppId, Source and DataSetWriterName (i.e. equal to the DataSetWriterName of the MAM DataSetMessage); an Identification Link provided by the asset is used unchanged, otherwise the generated one (e.g. the Oi4Identifier); a manufacturer-provided Identification Link is never overwritten by a generated one.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Scope: MG 4.3.2, MG 8.2.3
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-7b92aa74, MG-5-8895ae9f, MG-5-8d0992fd, MG-5-f63a5307

> The ProductInstanceUri shall contain the Identification Link of the asset (4 The Identification Link), i.e. the unencoded Identification Link that is used for this asset in the topic elements AppId and Source (7.3 AppId Element and 7.6 Source Element) and in the payload.
> — MG 5

> An Identification Link provided by the manufacturer must not be overwritten by a generated Identification Link such as the Oi4Identifier.
> — MG 5

Notes: Counterpart of REQ-IL-031 and REQ-MSG-023; "should be used" of MG 5 is read together with "must be provided here unchanged". Reclassified in C-041 (-schema, consistency review of the P2 exit, ADR-0019 §9): ProductInstanceUri = DataSetWriterName is an equality of two fields (R-3); no entry schema reports this requirement.

## REQ-RES-MAM-017

**ProductInstanceUri has at most 255 characters**

The ProductInstanceUri does not exceed 255 characters.

- Keyword: MUST NOT
- Levels: L1 MUST NOT · L2 MUST NOT · L3 MUST NOT
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-3380ef85

> According to the OPC UA specification and 4.1 IEC 61406-1 Identification Link, the ProductInstanceUri must not exceed 255 characters.
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-018

**RevisionCounter counts configuration changes of the asset**

Every change of the configuration of the asset, including changes of the master asset information, increments its RevisionCounter by one; a value taken from the VendorNameplate of the asset is used unchanged; an asset without revision counter uses -1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 5, SF-064
- Verification: d7-monitor
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-1cd0e95c, MG-5-3e6c1a1b, MG-5-f80a56c7

> Each change of the configuration of the asset, including changes of the master asset information, shall lead to an increment of the revision counter by one.
> — MG 5

> A value taken from the VendorNameplate of the asset shall be used unchanged.
> — MG 5

> If the asset does not support a revision counter, it shall be set to -1 (default of OPC UA Part 100).
> — MG 5

## REQ-RES-MAM-019

**Detected components get an Identification Link and a MAM**

Each component detected by an OEC application (physical thing or application) gets an Identification Link and a MAM.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application
- Condition: The application detects or represents further components.
- Refs: MG 5
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-0089cb54

> Each component, regardless if it is a physical thing or an application, which was detected by the OI4 Alliance framework, should get an Identification Link and a Master Asset Model.

## REQ-RES-MAM-020

**Get MAM carries no MAM object**

A Get MAM NetworkMessage contains no MAM DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.1, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.1-8bfafc5a

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage.
> — MG 9.1.1

> A MAM object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.1

## REQ-RES-MAM-021

**Get MAM is answered with all addressed MAM objects**

A Get MAM without Source is answered with all available MAM information of the application (itself and all subordinate assets), each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to Pub/MAM; a Get MAM with Source is answered with the MAM of that asset on Pub/MAM/&lt;Source>.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The entity supports Get for MAM (REQ-CMP-017).
- Refs: MG 9.1.1, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.1-5cf81496

> A topic such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/MAM must trigger a publication of all available MAM information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/MAM.
> — MG 9.1.1

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015. The Source case follows from the Get list item of MG 9.1.1.

## REQ-RES-MAM-022

**Pub MAM carries MAM objects and optionally Pagination**

A Pub MAM NetworkMessage contains MAM DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.1, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.1-d250fbb9

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type MAM – none in the answer to a Get without content (Resources Without Content) – and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.1

Notes: A Locale is only meaningful in a Get and ignored in other methods (REQ-LOC-003).

## REQ-RES-MAM-024

**Model available in en-US if used for the Oi4Identifier**

If the Model of the MAM is used as an element of the Oi4Identifier, the MAM provides Model at least in the locale en-US, so that the Text in en-US can be taken for the Oi4Identifier (REQ-IL-027). Other locales are optional (OPC UA does not require en-US in general).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The Model of the MAM is used as an element of the Oi4Identifier.
- Refs: MG 5, MG 4.3.1, MG 8.3.12
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-5-e24d1f2f

> If the Model is used as an element of the Oi4Identifier (4.3.1 Structure of the Oi4Identifier), it must at least be available in the locale English (en-US).
> — MG 5

Notes: PO request 2026-10-22 (moved from the former MG 5 Model rule, SF-064 (d)).
